The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Plate 10264 of the Russian Lives of the Saints (1903-1911), whose numbering puts it on 26 June - the folder's feast day. Captioned David. The day's first three plates are Mother-of-God icons (Tikhvin, Hodegetria, Lydda) kept on 26 June, and this fourth is the day's saint, David the dendrite of Thessalonica - the only David in the calendar for this day. Commons describes it: Иллюстрации к книге: Жития святых на русском языке, изложенные по руководству Четьих-Миней  с дополнениями, объяснительными примечаниями и изображениями святых
